card.text: Explore Lamberta in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: ADAM nonconvex reconstruction constrained by VLT/SPHERE images. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: DAMIT 5914 shape model
shape.summary: ADAM nonconvex reconstruction constrained by VLT/SPHERE images. Selected archive volume-equivalent diameter: 141 ±2 km. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative.

elevation.title: DAMIT 5914 radial height
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 70.5 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
